title: Read a route input
summary: Fastify: Read a route input. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: A colon marks a path parameter. GET /hello/Ravi puts the name in request.params.
learningObjectives: Read a route input with Fastify

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Read a route input

blocks.text: request.params.name contains Ravi. That value is inserted into the returned string.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Path values are text unless a schema converts and validates them.
